The app controller supplies data-motion-running only after supported hydration, intersection and document visibility, then freezes decoration within 4500ms of mounting through a one-way completion latch. components.name: Create account reference
components.description: Source-derived signup composition with native account-intent radios, real Display name/Email/Password constraints and local address guidance. This preview mirrors no-script/server markup: form fieldset disabled, visible JavaScript guidance, decorative animations paused and no motion button. In the app, SignUpArtwork alone supplies data-motion-running only after supported hydration, intersection and document visibility, then freezes decoration within 4500ms of mounting through a one-way completion latch. Hidden/offscreen time counts; visibility changes cannot restart completed motion. Timer, observer and visibility subscription clean up on unmount. The snippet does not supply that attribute or simulate authentication, verification or Show/Hide JavaScript. Existing validated parent/student continuations can select their intent; this ordinary preview shows Choose later. Signup container queries hide floats at 1180px, flatten the card and hide the orb at 900px, and stack intentions at 384px. Reduced motion defines no artwork loops; forced colors hides artwork. Source native inputs use enabled Navy hover/focus borders and a 4px Bright teal 28% focus shadow; native account choices use enabled Navy hover and a 4px Bright teal 35% visible-focus shadow, retaining strong resting borders and outlines. Border/background transitions take 150ms and shadow transitions take 200ms only under no-preference. Actual form aria-busy alone replaces the decorative arrow with an 800ms rotating ring, static under reduced motion. Disabled fields reset transitions/transforms immediately. This preserved server-state preview has aria-busy=false and does not trigger pending state. Signup form alerts use the existing White surface background so the stage ribbon cannot cross refusal text in the flattened narrow layout; message, markup and focus behavior are unchanged.

narrative.overview:
Learli's implemented brand kit 2.0 combines a paper ground, white working surfaces,
navy hierarchy and a restrained mint phrase highlight. Lexend makes the interface
direct and readable; Literata gives longer explanations and tutor biographies a
distinct reading voice. The original wordmark supplies the identity rather than
a newly drawn logo or decorative imagery.

The same flat materials carry public discovery, account forms and private lesson
coordination. Borders and spacing group work; native controls expose real choices
and current state. Synthetic testing notices, unavailable states and policy draft
labels remain visible. This is a derived reference for the current implementation,
not evidence of release, completed browser verification or real-user readiness.
Canonical authority remains [UI context](context/ui-context.md) and the product,

keyCharacteristics: Paper and white surfaces with navy hierarchy.
Lexend interface and explicit Literata reading passages.
Flat bordered panels and native accessible controls.

rules.name: The Readable Signal Rule
rules.body: Bright teal and Mint are fills or accents on light surfaces; body text and links use Ink, Navy, Slate or Deep teal. Never put white text on Bright teal.

rules.name: The Surface Focus Rule
rules.body: Focus is a two-pixel outline with a two-pixel offset; light surfaces use Deep teal, navy fields and checked matching choices use White. Text selection also reverses between navy-on-white and white-on-navy contexts.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Use Lexend for headings, forms, names, dates and lesson times. Apply Literata explicitly to longer explanations or biographies; the `prose` size token alone does not switch font family.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Group work with borders, tonal surfaces and spacing; do not add resting card shadows, glass or decorative elevation outside the documented owner-authorized exceptions below.

rules.name: The Complete Markup Rule
rules.body: Motion only withholds a decorative stroke that is still below the viewport. Text, links and final arrangements are in the server markup; reduced motion keeps each state and removes the travel.

rules.name: The Something Behind It Rule
rules.body: A sheet always lies over Learli's own material (photographs, the illustration, tonal rings, the scrolling page) and its text holds AA over all of it. Glass is never laid on an empty ground.

dos: **Do** use the shared semantic colors and type roles from the implemented CSS.
**Do** preserve original wordmarks and the icon, with reverse artwork on Navy.
**Do** keep native controls, visible labels, focus and truthful state text.
**Do** let actions, names, lesson times and time-zone context wrap on narrow or enlarged layouts.
**Do** use borders and spacing to group work on White and Paper surfaces.
**Do** keep the desktop public/auth navbar compact, with its original SVG, centered White capsule, light Mint hover/current fills, full names and visible focus.

**Do** keep the sign-in reference's local sizes, briefly running decoration and unboxed form scoped to `/sign-in`, preserving the 4500ms settling bound, real form states, static fallbacks and other auth frames.

**Do** keep the Create account reference's card, abstract academic decoration and local feedback scoped to `/sign-up`, preserving the 4500ms artwork settling bound, all three native intentions and real form states.
donts: **Don't** use Bright teal or Mint as ordinary text on a light surface.

**Don't** add card shadows, glass, decorative gradients or invented imagery outside the public home page and shared header, apart from the documented local sign-in submit shadow and Create account reference's card/artwork/submit shadows and dot field; glass remains for floating layers and photographs stay in the hero, illustrative and uncaptioned.
**Don't** animate outside the public home page and shared header/footer beyond short state transitions and the documented local sign-in and Create account motion; never hide content behind animation.
**Don't** turn kit example practice sets, messages or progress screens into product functionality.
**Don't** invent tutors, availability, reviews, prices or customer claims to fill a layout.
**Don't** hide synthetic notices, policy drafts, private-data boundaries or booking state for visual polish.
**Don't** add underlines to desktop public/auth navbar links or apply its compact sizing and pale sheet to mobile or private workspace navigation.
